# Draft:NUMB (X-Dynasty philosophy)

NUMB (stylized in uppercase) is a philosophy by Nigerian online streamer and content creator X-Dynasty. He developed the philosophy after his bail due to an arrest caused by he assaulting a person. The philosophy resonated seemingly quick among his audience. He created the philosophy as a way to teach his viewers to stay unshaken by problems deal with depression.
Recognition
After X-Dynasty’s bail, he developed the ‘’NUMB’’ philosophy which made his streams surge rapidly high due to the fact that it deeply resonated with his audience thus bringing him more online recognition.
